# Simply Sunde UI (vendored)

The Simply Sunde brand's theme and fonts, v0.1 — the same files simplysunde.no serves.
Don't edit them here: an update is a fresh copy of all of them.

Loskai uses only the theme's tokens (`--ss-*`) and the fonts: the look `html.brand` in
`src/index.css` remaps Loskai's palette to them (Settings › General › Look). Its element
styles apply inside `.ss`, which Loskai never sets.

- `simplysunde.css` — the theme; its token block holds the colours
- `LICENSE-yorha` — MIT notice for YoRHa, the CSS it builds on
- `fonts.css` and `fonts/` — the three fonts and their OFL notices
